Weekday Lunch Diaries
chicken ghee roast | dosa 

a plate of complete comfort and packed with so much flavour, this is one of my favourite meals i recently made
this chicken ghee roast is special because it only uses 1 tbsp of ghee for the entire portion and lean chicken breasts making it a much much healthier version of this beloved dish!
